tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who Alpha Flow Tech is, what it does, how it works with clients, and how to contact a person.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search everything Alpha Flow Tech offers, with prices in South African rand: website packages and add-ons, app and game packages, software bridges, automation services and software licences. Returns item ids for estimate and request_order.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full details of one catalogue item by id.

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Totals the 'from' prices for a list of item ids (once-off and monthly, in rand). Add-ons included free with a chosen website package count as zero.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Alpha Flow Tech's guides: website and app costs in South Africa (2026), stopping AI copying a website, stock systems and Sage, and connecting business software. Each has a short answer and a link.

tools.name: request_order
tools.description: Sends the person's order or quote request to the Alpha Flow Tech team, who reply to confirm one fixed price in writing. Nothing is charged. Only call this when the person asked for it and agreed to share their contact details.
